qualification: deterministic working-tree regressions; no release publication or platform qualification

artifactLinkage.qualificationAttempt: initial executed gate plus at most two proved fresh hosted-runner GUI-only retries
artifactLinkage.runAttempt: independent positive GitHub workflow correlation; gaps and values above three are permitted
artifactLinkage.receiptBinding: original job, source, installer digest, sample, workflow attempt, qualification ordinal and hosted runner ID
artifactLinkage.updater: actual discoverDesktopUpdate parser verifies admitted version, installer name, digest, byte size and canonical URL after promotion before finalization returns

notExecuted: GitHub API history or mutations, workflow dispatch, tag creation, npm, deployment or release promotion
Native full validation, signed DMG or hosted macOS GUI checks
QA1 owner URL, credential or profile operations
limits: Unknown historical source/version identity still refuses admission
Legacy or incomplete receipts cannot qualify new success or prove fresh-runner retry
Post-promotion updater discovery failure leaves the release public but produces no successful finalization receipt; existing no-op proof requirements still apply
